main.description: The drive's settings, which every device follows. Written when the drive is created, and when a device is approved or removed. Sealed, so the PDS can't change them. The sealed payload is {retentionDays (default 30), driveID, roster: [{id, name, publicKey}]}: how long history is kept; a random ID (a drive with another one was wiped and created again); and the devices approved to hold the drive's keys, whose public keys keyrings are wrapped for and accepted from.
